item.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
item.description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Republicans hope unconventional convention will rally voters ahead of midterms
item.description: The Republican party is calling it a "Trumpapalooza." The party is throwing an unconventional convention in Dallas this week to try to boost Republican voter enthusiasm.

item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with commentator Jonah Goldberg about this week's unusual Republican midterm gathering.

item.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
item.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

item.title: Trump's construction projects are transforming the capital
item.description: President Trump is transforming Washington. New York Magazine's Ben Terris says the ballroom, the planned arch and other changes are an attempt to achieve "architectural immortality."

item.title: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
item.description: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.

item.title: Public backlash against data centers is rising. Politicians are playing catchup
item.description: Public sentiment against data centers is running high this election season, leaving politicians of all stripes scrambling to respond. We look at how this is playing out in Pennsylvania.

item.title: Politics chat: First-ever Republican midterm convention or Trump rally?
item.description: A first-ever Republican midterm convention is taking place this week in Dallas, but are candidates interested in attending? Plus, Michigan's Democratic senate candidate apologizes to Jewish voters.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner call Kyiv talks 'substantive' after Moscow Putin meeting
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held meetings in Kyiv with Ukraine's President Zelenskyy on Sunday, a day after lengthy conversations with Russian President Putin in Moscow.
